answer: We formalize a mechanism where each node must harbor a dynamic opportunity-cost bond proportional to its marginal extractable rent, precluding profitable identity replication. A subgame-perfect slashing matrix then renders any Sybil deviation strictly negative in expected payoff, forcing adversarial agents into a deflationary orchard of isolated pseudonyms. Consequently, best-response dynamics spiral toward a strict Nash equilibrium in which honest participation uniquely dominates.
